name: gap-healing
description: Find entities the store keeps referencing but has never written down, draft the missing entries, and file them as proposals for review — never as direct writes.

min_mentions.help: How many distinct items must reference a name before the gap is worth drafting.

metadata.why_proposals: A drafted entry nobody reviewed becomes a citable source for the next draft, and two generations later the store cites itself as evidence. Direct-write healing is the studied anti-pattern; this template files proposals and stops.

steering_examples.description: Find names the store keeps referencing but never wrote up, and draft entries for review.
Only draft the ones with at least five referencing items — the rest are too thin.

with.title: Knowledge gaps — {{nodes.gaps.output.count}} referenced but unwritten
with.summary: Drafted entries for referenced-but-missing entities, pending review.
